name: Leila Dubois
headline: Software Engineer
summary: Software Engineer with experience building and operating cloud infrastructure, monitoring services, and automating environment management. Known for improving reliability, tightening access controls, and supporting production teams across distributed platforms. Comfortable working across incident response, deployment operations, and system-level troubleshooting.
